product.olivetti-m28.summary: 8 MHz 80286 system with FE2000 logic, Olivetti OGC video and a documented 20 MB commercial configuration.
product.olivetti-m28.history: The 1986 M28 combined an 80286 at 8 MHz with Olivetti's FE2000 logic, 512 KB of standard memory, a 1.2 MB floppy drive and a 20 MB slim hard disk in the CPU 2801 configuration. Its own display controller supported Olivetti monochrome and colour displays. Later expansion included 1 MB on-board memory and the ME903/MEM2852 memory board.
product.olivetti-m28.warning: PARTIAL EMULATION: POST, RTC, CMOS, floppy boot and 1 MB on-board memory are recorded as passing. The commercial 512 KB/20 MB profile uses the GO714, emulated with the WD1003 without its jumpers, and ST-225 geometry as an approximation; the actual Olivetti drive remains to be confirmed. ME903 expansion, warm reset and two interactive diagnostics are pending.
product.olivetti-m28.creation.model: CPU 2801 commercial configuration: 512 KB, one 1.2 MB floppy drive and 20 MB hard disk
product.olivetti-m28.creation.hard_disk: Standard Olivetti 20 MB drive, type 2, on the GO714 controller (WD1003-WA2)
product.olivetti-m28.creation.note: The profile represents the standard Olivetti 20 MB drive, type 2 in Setup, on the GO714, the controller Olivetti documents for the M28 with BIOS 2.07 or later. The blank MFM image uses 615/4/17; the GO714's own drive table has not been recovered and its jumpers are not modelled.
product.olivetti-m28.technical.cpu: Intel 80286 at an 8 MHz bus, with Olivetti FE2000 proprietary system logic.
product.olivetti-m28.technical.memory: 512 KB was documented for CPU 2801 and can be expanded to 1 MB on-board. With 1 MB installed, the recorded diagnostics observe 640 KB conventional plus 384 KB remapped extended memory. The ME903/MEM2852 expansion board is documented but not modelled.
product.olivetti-m28.technical.video: Olivetti's own OGC controller, shared with related Olivetti systems. The current model exposes the aliases used by Customer Test, while an interactive alias retest remains pending.
product.olivetti-m28.technical.storage: The service manual documents a 20 MB slim drive or a 40 MB full-height drive, with the controller at primary 1F0h, IRQ14 and DMA3. Olivetti lists the GO714 (WD1003-WA2, ST506/MFM with floppy) for the M28 with BIOS 2.07 or later; BluMach emulates it with the WD1003 and 615/4/17 geometry for the 20 MB profile.
product.olivetti-m28.technical.firmware: Known 32 KiB BIOS pairs are PBUY/PBUX 2.09 and PBU6/PBU7 2.12. The 2.12 pair is the default because it is the latest locally validated set; the shipping BIOS for CPU 2801 is not yet established.
product.olivetti-m28.technical.verified: Recorded validation confirms cold POST, RTC/CMOS, floppy boot and 1 MB memory. The catalogue profile uses the documented 512 KB commercial baseline and launches without proprietary media.
product.olivetti-m28.technical.limitatio: The ME903 memory expansion does not exist. Warm reset, an interactive keyboard subtest and a video alias subtest remain open. The GO714 is emulated with the WD1003: its jumpers are not modelled, it stays at 1F0h and IRQ 14, the machine still provides the floppy controller, and it resets on a soft reset.
